mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% signals sustained monetary accommodation, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC over 12 months remains <0.02.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 235.0 indicates accelerating inflation, triggering expectations of rate hikes that reduce equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235.0, or Rank IC over 12 months <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth >0.3% MoM and UNRATE decline >0.2pp signals labor market recovery, strengthening corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases >0.3% MoM and UNRATE decreases >0.2pp
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when PAYEMS growth >0.3% MoM and UNRATE decline >0.2pp, or Rank IC <0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, HOUST below 1050 indicates weak consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST < 1050 in post-pandemic recovery, or Rank IC <0.02.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 above 16000 signals robust economic expansion, increasing corporate profitability and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 > 16000, or Rank IC over 12 months <0.02.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE above 5.5% indicates labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC over 12 months <0.02.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO above 105.0 and HOUST above 1000.0 indicate synchronized supply-demand strength, boosting manufacturing output and consumer spending for positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0 and HOUST > 1000.0, or Rank IC <0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In a low inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 240), CPIAUCSL below 240 supports continued monetary accommodation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 240, or Rank IC over 12 months <0.02.
